lines.en: I do not retreat, humming as I advance.
Bone by bone, I clatter forward.
I can't be pushed — I just keep walking

lines.zh: 仪式还没结束，我不能倒。
lines.en: The ritual is not over; I cannot fall.

lines.zh: 骨节咬着骨节，一步步挪。
lines.en: Bone grinding on bone, one step at a time.
Chains drag on the floor as it closes in.
Its thick flesh presses forward, step by step.

lines.zh: 仪式的鼓点在我胸里敲。
lines.en: The rite's drum beats inside my chest.
I stand while the shield dims and glows.
The rite isn't done. I wait.
Inside the ritual circle it does not move.
It waits for the next stage of the rite.
Its flesh rises and falls as it breathes slowly.
It stands at the center of the sacrificial ground.
In the silence its shadow does not stir.
It turns its gaze to the altar.

lines.zh: 我看你的眼神像在看祭品。
lines.en: I look at you as one looks at an offering.
The ritual altar is lit, and I arrive.

lines.zh: 仪式火光照进我的眼窝。
lines.en: Ritual firelight fills my eye sockets.

lines.zh: 仪式台的灯，全为我点着。
lines.en: Every lamp on the ritual stage is lit for me.

lines.zh: 我的空洞眼睛对准你了。
lines.en: My hollow eyes are fixed on you.

lines.zh: 别看我，我的盔甲还没醒。
lines.en: Don't stare — my armor hasn't woken yet.
I watch you; my shield is not broken yet.

lines.zh: 它认出了闯入仪式的人
lines.en: It recognizes the one who broke into the rite.
The hollow in its eyes turns toward you.
It raises its head and slowly aligns with you.
Something like your name squeezes from its throat.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，像在称量祭品
lines.en: It stares as if weighing a sacrifice.

lines.zh: 视线停在你手上的武器
lines.en: Its gaze settles on the weapon in your hand.

lines.zh: 吼声渐弱，力量似乎在流失。
身上裂痕出现，生命在消逝。
皮肤开始剥落，肉眼可见的伤害。
翅膀受损，飞行变得艰难。
眼中失去了光芒，精神受创。
身体僵硬，即将陷入虚弱。
力量衰退，战斗即将结束。
你靠近了，但我还没结束！
lines.en: You're getting close, but I'm not done yet!
The altar fire urges me on.
My ritual is not yet complete!
Your flesh will nourish the earth!

lines.zh: 你靠近一点，护盾就薄了。
lines.en: Come closer and my shield thins.
The ritual is about to end!

lines.zh: 我的甲片下面全是符文。
lines.en: Beneath my plates there is nothing but runes.

lines.zh: 护盾亮起，击退对我没用。
lines.en: My shield flares; knockback does nothing.

lines.zh: 击退对我不生效，你省点力。
lines.en: Knockback fails on me. Save your strength.

lines.zh: 我的护甲连击退都不吃。
你的武器连我的甲都刮不动。
lines.en: Your weapon cannot even scratch my plate.

lines.zh: 你的力量在我面前不堪一击！
lines.en: Your strength is useless against me!

lines.zh: 与我一同完成这场仪式。

lines.en: I'm immune to knockback; stop pushing.
Nothing touches the ground around my altar.

lines.zh: 注意了，我的力量不容小觑！
lines.en: Watch out, my strength is no joke!

lines.zh: 你们闻到我的气息了吗？
这是我的仪式，你们无法理解！
lines.en: This is my ritual, you can't comprehend it!

lines.zh: 我的力量源自深渊，无法摧毁！
lines.en: My power comes from the depths, it can't be destroyed!

lines.zh: 你们的食物只能是灵魂！

lines.en: Knockback does nothing to me. Stand still.

lines.zh: 我的守护者将净化这片土地！
lines.en: My guardians will cleanse this land!

lines.zh: 我的弱点只开一瞬，你抓得住吗？
lines.en: My weakness opens for an instant; can you catch it?

lines.zh: 我的目光如刀，你无法逃脱！
lines.en: My gaze is a blade, you can't escape!

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，我的爪子已锁定！
lines.en: You can't escape, my claws are on you!

lines.zh: 仪式的圈已经画完，进来吧。
lines.en: The ritual circle is complete — step in.
I smell the blood of an offering.
The sacrifice walked in on its own.
The ritual needs its share of you.

lines.zh: 你踏进了它的仇恨范围
lines.en: You stepped into its sixty-four-block reach.
It has added you to the list.
Here comes the guest of the third act.

lines.zh: 你已是这场仪式的道具
lines.en: You are now a prop in this ritual.
It has saved a place for you.
The shield holds; you cannot move me.
In this phase you cannot touch me.
My tentacles won't let you go!

lines.zh: 我的吸盘将吸取你的力量！
lines.en: My suckers will drain your power!
The ritual enters its next stage.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚出低沉的祷词
lines.en: A low prayer rolls from its throat.
It waits for your first swing.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我便压上去一尺。
lines.en: You step back; I press a foot closer.

lines.zh: 它把攻击留到最后一刻
lines.en: It saves the blow for the very last moment.
The flame on the altar sinks low.
Its huge palm falls and the altar cracks.
The blow lands and bones creak.
It grabs you and hurls you at the wall.
A chain lashes out, throwing sparks.

lines.zh: 祭坛点起最后一支蜡烛
lines.en: The altar lights its last candle.
The rite is done and it rises.
The door of the third act has shut.
The stone door swings open and it opens its eyes.
The blood circle closes and the boss takes form.
The story reaches this page and it enters.

lines.zh: 空气变冷，它从祭坛后走出
lines.en: The air turns cold and it steps from behind the altar.

lines.zh: 蜡烛全灭，它已站在你面前
lines.en: Every candle dies and it stands before you.
Its name has been spoken aloud.

lines.zh: 火舔上我的甲，我吭了一声。
lines.en: Fire licks my plate and I grunt once.

lines.zh: 水里试过了，仪式还没开始。
lines.en: Tried water. The ritual has not even begun.

lines.zh: 爆炸推不动我，可里面疼。
lines.en: The blast cannot move me, but it hurts inside.
